gaps: P0, P1, P2, P5: no candidates. P6: only a dull overcast Liffey view (#18) and a parking-lot panorama of Dublin Castle (#19); skipped
notes: Kingstown and Howth photochroms (#7–10) are separate towns, not the city; #2 and #4 show Heywood in Queen’s County; #20 is Dublin, California. Malton’s colored Royal Exchange (1792, #5) is a good fallback for P3 but too close in date to #1 to take both. #3 (1826 lithograph from Phoenix Park) left out: soldiers fill the foreground and the city is indistinct. Fore-edge painting (#6) has no date of its own. #18 could serve as a weak P6 if wanted.
